description:
Read a site's latest crawl_site run (or run_id): Site Health 0–100, theme scores, every failing check, what wasn't checked and problem pages.

Billing: free — reads the stored run; nothing is fetched.

Staleness: a run older than 30 days, or made before the crawler fixes of 2026-09-24, has stale: true — don't verify fixes against it; crawl again. Every page failed: status "failed". A run crawled before Site Audit checks has coverage: "legacy" (issue rollup only). cwv_state "pending": Core Web Vitals still measuring; read again in minutes. Never report not_run checks as passed.

Inputs:
  site_id  — the AuditAE site id (from list_sites).
  run_id   — optional earlier run (history[].run_id).
  theme    — adds that theme's report: score, its checks with why and fix, and details (status, depth and load-time buckets, robots, sitemaps, TLS, hreflang, per-page Core Web Vitals, AI bot access).
  severity — error, warning or notice: filters checks.
  checks   — with theme: 'failing' (default) or 'all' (adds passed).
  check    — a check id: pages are those failing it, plus its rule, why and fix.
  pages    — 'issues' (default; 'none' with theme: pages failing an error or warning check, worst first, as { url, http_status, depth, checks, inlinks, ilr }), 'all' or 'none'.
  limit    — pages per call, default 10 (legacy runs 25), max 100; offset — pass next_offset.

Returns: { site_id, run: { run_id, status, completed_at, pages_crawled, billed_cents, settings, … }, stale, coverage, stage, site_health, counts (by severity), themes: { <id>: { score, failing, ran } }, cwv_state, checks: [{ id, severity, title, n, of }] (≤40, worst first), not_run: [{ id, reason }], vs_previous? (change since the crawl before; incomplete_baseline?/note?: a capped crawl inflates new; diff: compare_crawls), history (last 5 runs), schedule, theme?, check?, issues_summary (counts), pages_view, pages_total, next_offset, pages, suggested_next?, next_step, note? }. While crawling: provisional: true counts. { run: null }: never crawled.

check.description: A check id from checks[].id: lists the pages failing it, with its rule, why and fix.

checks.description: With theme: 'failing' (default) or 'all' (adds the theme's passed checks).

limit.description: Pages per call. Default 10 (fewer when long URLs would push the answer past 12 KB; next_offset continues), legacy runs 25; max 100.

offset.description: Default 0. Use next_offset from the previous answer.

run_id.description: Optional run id (history[].run_id). Default: the latest run.

theme.description: Adds this theme's report: score, checks with why and fix, details.

name: get_latest_crawl
title: Fetch a site's latest crawl: Site Health, theme scores and failing checks
